D.t: Eugene Vindman leads by 21.2 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 71,410 votes; a one point swing is about 1,687 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +13.7 and D +28.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$6.6M cash against $66K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
